text:
alex: Quick announcement for SF hub attendees next week: we're trialing a "Family Support Pilot" — Family Lounge in Lactation Room 3B + limited subsidized caregiver parking. TL;DR: form link at the end, receipts to Expensify, passes are first-come-first-served.

maya: This is great, thanks! A couple of things: are the parking subsidies only for weekdays?

alex: Yes. Subsidized parking covers Mon00Fri, 8am008pm during the onsite window. Weekend parking is standard rates.

devin: Clarify "caregiver" 10 does this include paid sitters/nannies?

alex: It does. Definition: immediate family (spouse, partner, children, dependent elders) or paid caregiver (sitter, nanny, in-home eldercare) while you're onsite. Stipend: up to $150/day for up to 3 days. Submit receipts to Expensify and tag expense category "family-onsite".

ryan: Any manager approval required to claim the stipend?

alex: No manager approval for the stipend itself. If you need exceptions (more than 3 days, extended hours), please DM People Ops and loop your manager.

facilities: Logistics: Lactation Room 3B is repurposed as the Family Lounge during the pilot. Amenities: small fridge, changing table, lockers, white-noise machine, privacy screen, and a small play mat with sanitized toy bins. Book via https://cal.redwood/lactation-3B. Please keep it tidy for other families.

maya: Will there be an internal list of vetted sitters/vendors?

alex: Yes — we00ll publish a vetted provider list tomorrow (all vendors have background checks). Note: Redwood does not act as an employer or contractor intermediary for sitters; the stipend reimburses your expense.

devin: ADA parking requests? Special cases?

facilities: ADA/accessible parking is handled separately. DM facilities with your badge number and we00ll reserve an accessible spot for the dates needed. That reserved spot does not consume the subsidized pass allocation.

ryan: Shuttle question: can we add a temporary stop closer to 4th & Market for parents?

ops-bot: shuttle-schedule: temporary stop added at 4th & Market for Thu00Fri of the onsite week. Calendar invites updated.

maya: How do we request the parking pass?

alex: Fill the short request form: https://tiny.redwood/family-pass. We email a QR parking pass within 48 hours of approval. Passes are limited and allocated FCFS.

devin: If I need an exception for additional days, who reviews that?

alex: DM People Ops (alex) with dates and a brief reason. Exceptions reviewed case-by-case.

ryan: Will there be a quiet feeding chair and sink in the lounge?

facilities: Yes 10 comfy chair, small sink, and hand sanitizer. Please follow posted hygiene rules.

maya: Thanks, good to know receipts are private.

alex: Reminder: receipts submitted to Expensify must include provider name, date, and amount. Tag "family-onsite." For privacy, only People Ops and Finance will see the receipt details.

devin: Filing the form now. Appreciate the pilot.

alex: We'll post the vetted provider list, FAQ, and an accessibility contact tomorrow. Ping me for urgent needs.
